say:1:1222709001:1.text: Look at that golden, graceful body and that shade of vivid blue on its tail! It shakes off the hook with such elegance... Must be the legendary golden peacock!
say:1:1222709001:1.source_cn: 金黄的鱼影，婀娜的身姿，再加上尾巴那抹鲜亮的绿色，还能...

say:2:1222709002:1.text: It's even bigger and more magnificent than I imagined... No wonder the rich folks of Rustport are all obsessed with it!
say:2:1222709002:1.source_cn: 它比我想象的更巨大，也更华丽……难怪锈锚港的有钱人都对...

say:4:1222709003:1.text: You let it slip away right in front of you, aren't you upset?
say:4:1222709003:1.source_cn: 呃，你好像一点也不失望的样子呢……

say:5:1222709004:1.text: Not at all! The fact that the golden peacock shows up proves that I'm on the right track. It's just a matter of time before I catch it!
say:5:1222709004:1.source_cn: 为什么要失望？既然黄金孔雀出现了，那就说明我的方法没错...

say:6:1222709005:1.text: Guys, please let me know if you come across any signs of the golden peacock in the future! My research report depends on it!
say:6:1222709005:1.source_cn: 几位，如果你们以后发现了黄金孔雀的踪迹，也记得告诉我一...

say:8:1222709006:1.text: Don't worry. We'll make sure to remember!
say:8:1222709006:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我们一定会记得的！
